body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung showcased a new Duo HD disc player ‘BD-UP5500’ for HD home entertainment during the press conference at CES 2008, which features Blu-ray Bonus View player packaged in a slim and sleek cabinet design.

The BD-UP5500 supports the latest audio decoding. With 7.1-Ch PCM, DTS-HD high-resolution and Master audio, and Dolby TrueHD Bistream output via HDMI 1.3, the BD-UP5500 accurately reproduces every delicate nuance with lifelike precision, just as the directors intended. For those consumers who still want to enjoy their existing collection of DVDs and CDs, Samsung’s BD-UP5500 is also a fully-functioning DVD and CD player.
It will be available in the second-half of 2008.
